scientific_question: Using exact real FFN-down weights from the current model, does a model-load-only NPU representation preserve numerical semantics and retain a positive warm transfer budget after activation movement and graph lifecycle are accounted for?

structural_outcome_blind_layer_selection.rule: For each quant family independently, select first, upper-middle index floor(n/2), and last layer in ascending layer order before any real-weight NPU outcome is observed.

operator_contract.provider_representation: FP16 constant weights with MatMul transpose_b=true

numerical_reference.source_reference: GGUF Q4_K/Q6_K dequantized to FP32 using gguf.dequantize; reference y = W_fp32 @ x_fp32
numerical_reference.representation_reference: FP16-converted weights and FP16-converted activation promoted to FP32 for y = W_fp16_as_f32 @ x_fp16_as_f32
numerical_reference.provider_result: OpenVINO NPU imported compiled graph output
numerical_reference.threshold_provenance: Same conservative max_abs/rmse gate previously frozen for ArcLLM Q4-down component correctness on the same FFN-down operator family.

provider_lifecycle.timed_infer_boundary: synchronous imported_model infer call with host FP16 input supplied and output materialized through provider result object

warm_transfer_metric.case_metric: median of 9 imported-graph synchronous infer wall times
warm_transfer_metric.GPU_budget_provenance: Parent NPU capability/transfer/Amdahl gate analytical current-canonical projection from exact post-I002 M1 evidence plus measured Q4V4 B/0 effect.

lifecycle_analysis.break_even_tokens: setup_projection / warm_savings_ms_per_token, separately for W-S and W-C

outcome_classes.PASS_REAL_WEIGHT_WARM_TRANSFER: all numerical cases pass AND primary positive budget rule passes
outcome_classes.PASS_REAL_WEIGHT_WARM_TRANSFER_MATERIAL: all numerical cases pass AND secondary material rule passes
outcome_classes.FAIL_WARM_TRANSFER_BUDGET: numerics pass but primary positive budget rule fails
outcome_classes.STOP_PROVIDER_OR_INTEGRITY: provider/device/model/type/shape/integrity contract fails before admissible complete evidence
